verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Radar goes beyond transaction fraud: Radar Standard can 'identify fraudulent accounts' [docs-6], and Radar Pro detects 'customer abuse', including multi-account, free trial and pay-as-you-go abuse [docs-16]. This covers fake accounts and some policy abuse within Radar, but it needs the Pro tier, and the rest of the documented tooling (rules, reviews, risk settings) is payment-centric. missing for 10: account takeover detection, explicit promo/coupon abuse scoring, evidence that non-payment events (signup, login) are scored and managed in the same rules/review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the abuse features.
